note: P6 W6.3 adversarial manifest [P6-C50, P6-C75]. Freezes (a) the exact section-7 focused test-file set (the union of every W0-W6 checkpoint list plus the seven W6.5 regression neighbours) and (b) the TWENTY-ONE section-9 attack ids [P6-C50]. assertP6GateResults.ts validates the vitest gate JSON in --results mode (no failed/skipped/todo, gateFiles set-equal the reported files, every attack owned by a passing test titled 'refuses: <id>') and the per-attack artifact directory in --attack-root mode (each id present once, passed:true, nonempty assertion, artifact path; --require-exact N forbids a stray or missing artifact and must equal the frozen 21). Every attack is owned by server/testFixtures/p6TwoDaemonFixture.test.ts, which drives the same in-process attack probe p6TwoDaemonFixture.ts --attack runs at the wire, so the results-mode ownership and the attack-root artifacts agree. server/schedules/routes.test.ts is deliberately absent: no such file exists [P6-C30].

attacks.title: refuses: missing-auth
attacks.summary: Every /api/v1 route with no operator subject and no node header is 401 before any store read.

attacks.title: refuses: forged-proxy-header
attacks.summary: A Tailscale-Node-ID from a non-node-proxy peer is 401 untrusted-peer; a stopped proxy answers 502 from the simulated 8444 listener with NO dashboard 503 and 443 still 200; a stopped shim is 503 node-attribution-unavailable from the dashboard.

attacks.title: refuses: forged-node-id
attacks.summary: A well-formed node id absent from the map is 403 and the body names no map contents.

attacks.title: refuses: revoked-node-id
attacks.summary: A node id in revoked is 403 node-revoked.

attacks.title: refuses: wrong-host-object
attacks.summary: The Desktop node calling PUT /api/v1/hosts/vm or renewing a VM-held lease is 403 wrong-host.

attacks.title: refuses: operator-calls-daemon-route
attacks.summary: An operator peer calling advertise/claim/renew/report is 403 node-route-only, and the operator uid on an operator route is fine; the proxy uid on an operator route is 403 operator-route-only.

attacks.title: refuses: host-attempts-human-response
attacks.summary: A report payload carrying a decision/assertion field fails the exact-key wall 400 before any store write, and the Desktop read proxy has no respond route at all.

attacks.title: refuses: wrong-kind-etag
attacks.summary: A foreign-domain ETag (a Run ETag on a host precondition) is 412, never a silent success.

attacks.title: refuses: stale-cursor
attacks.summary: A cursor minted under an older watermark is 409 cursor-stale.

attacks.title: refuses: changed-idempotency-replay
attacks.summary: The three node heartbeat routes (advertise/renew/report) are accepted with NO Idempotency-Key; a replayed advertise is a no-op by CAS and a replayed report is 409 report-out-of-order by sequence.

attacks.title: refuses: out-of-order-report
attacks.summary: sequence != lastReportSequence + 1 is 409 report-out-of-order with no state change.

attacks.title: refuses: duplicate-completion
attacks.summary: A second completed/failed on a terminal run is 409 run-already-terminal and terminalOutcome is unchanged.

attacks.title: refuses: out-of-order-gate
attacks.summary: A gate-opened report after the run is terminal is refused.

attacks.title: refuses: expired-lease
attacks.summary: Renew or report past expiresAt is 409 lease-expired, and the run becomes claimable again exactly once across both reclaim mechanisms.

attacks.title: refuses: lease-theft
attacks.summary: The Desktop node renewing under a VM-held lease is 403 wrong-host even with a correct revision.

attacks.title: refuses: false-capability
attacks.summary: A run whose capabilityHash no longer matches the advertisement is not dispatched.

attacks.title: refuses: stale-advertisement
attacks.summary: An advertisement older than the freshness window is not a candidate; the launch refuses no-complete-placement.

attacks.title: refuses: split-brain
attacks.summary: Two concurrent claims for the same run produce exactly one lease row and one loser.

attacks.title: refuses: oversized-unknown-input
attacks.summary: An advertisement over a section-3.1 bound is 413 and not truncated; an unknown key in any v1 body is 400 before any store read.

attacks.title: refuses: node-flood
attacks.summary: A node driven above its own budget gets 429 for that node only while the operator surface stays responsive.

attacks.title: refuses: capability-loss
attacks.summary: A host that re-advertises without a capability its live lease requires gets 409 capability-lost on its next renew.
